en.name: Eucharistic Miracle of Canosio
en.summary: A catastrophic flood is said to have been halted by a priest blessing the waters with the Blessed Sacrament.
en.body: In 1630, as floodwaters threatened to destroy the village of Canosio, the parish priest is reported to have blessed the raging waters with the Blessed Sacrament, after which the flood receded and the village was spared.
